name: Befouled by Satyr
summary: Takata Steelblade in Desolace asks you to confront several kinds of Hatefury satyr. Their presence is the problem he needs you to address.

sections.title: Takata's Request
sections.body: Takata Steelblade asks for your help in Desolace. Hatefury Rogues, Felsworn, Betrayers, and Hellcallers are the satyr he names. He needs you to slay seven of each, then return to him.

faq.q: Who asks for help with the Hatefury satyr?
faq.answer: Takata Steelblade asks you to confront the Hatefury satyr in Desolace.

faq.q: Which Hatefury satyr does Takata name?
faq.answer: Takata names Hatefury Rogues, Felsworn, Betrayers, and Hellcallers.

faq.q: How many of each kind does Takata ask you to slay?
faq.answer: Takata asks you to slay seven of each kind he names.

faq.q: Where do you return after dealing with the satyr?
faq.answer: Takata asks you to return to him in Desolace.

attribution: In-game quest text: Befouled by Satyr
